image_description: A reddish-brown plastic barrel with a black screw-top lid, situated outdoors on a gravel surface. The barrel features horizontal reinforcing ribs and a white rectangular label with illegible text/logos on the upper right side. A vertical pipe or downspout is visible to the left, and wooden structures are on the right.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the white label on the barrel. If the text is completely nonsensical or melted, this is a strong indicator of AI generation.
